sources.title: PREPARE TRANSACTION
supports: PostgreSQL的准备命令把准备状态持久保存，使后续可以按协调结果继续处理；准备完成仍不等于业务已经提交。

quotation.text: After this command, the transaction is no longer associated with the current session; instead, its state is fully stored on disk, and there is a very high probability that it can be committed successfully, even if a database crash occurs before the commit is requested.
